correctness.rationale: Grounded matrix invertibility yields an analytic stable nonlinear synchronized branch for bounded quenched frequencies. Even Taylor expansion identifies the stationary unpinned order-parameter loss with a centered inverse-grounded-Laplacian-square trace. The exact Dirichlet kernel provides closed F and H formulas; their two-block combination is a strictly concave quadratic in the arc product. Exact endpoint differences give adjacent anchors for N=4,5,6 and balanced anchors for every N>=7, with no other minimizers. Uniform remainders at each fixed graph size give genuine small-disorder optimality. The packaged script passed 355 exact/symbolic/exhaustive-finite and optional nonlinear numerical checks; the infinite claim rests on the proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: The unpinned-only Kuramoto order parameter is a natural physical observable distinct from pin-phase tracking. The result is a complete and sharp geometry classification for all finite cycle sizes, exposes a nonobvious inversion at seven vertices, and explains why a standard even-spacing rule from leader-following cannot be transferred to this centered statistical observable. This is a useful boundary for optimal subsystem resetting, without claiming a general network theorem.
